title: Efficacy and Tolerability of Beclomethasone Dipropionate 100 µg + Formoterol 6 µg pMDI Via HFA-134a Vs. Budesonide 160 µg + Formoterol 4,5 µg Dry Powder Via Turbuhaler®. (Symbicort®)
brief_summary: The aim of this study was to compare the efficacy and tolerability of the fixed combination beclomethasone/formoterol pMDI with that of budesonide/formoterol dry powder via Turbuhaler.
